coordinate_system: Canonical key pixels centered at rig key center. Baseline size is source rig frame31 width/height. Runtime world point = center + clockwiseRotate(angle) * [canonical.x*pose.width/base.width, canonical.y*pose.height/base.height]. Use existing rig alpha; draw existing foreground hand above all key layers.
path_fill_rule: evenOdd for all letter contours; keep inner loops (holes). Plate contours are convex measured hulls with64 fixed perimeter samples. Quadratic midpoint smoothing is appropriate for plates, not mandatory for letters.

confidence.latent_top_edge_under_hand: Convex hull closes only under the occluding finger; no invented visible notch.

orange.static_plate_reason: Source inverse-mapped outer/face geometry remains stable across measured presses and repeat scene within raster precision; existing rig width/height/rotation captures large pose changes.
orange.ink_fit_note: Least-squares source RGB fit against measured contour coverage rendered at16x then downsampled; native antialiasing can differ. Prior raw core-q10 and observed median retained.
